SELECT id, name, code, status, is_cross_entity AS isCrossEntity, remark AS remark, organization_id AS organizationId, create_time AS createTime, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_user_business_entity ub WHERE ub.business_entity_id = ad_business_entity.id AND ub.deleted = 0) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ad_order o WHERE o.business_entity_id = ad_business_entity.id) AS orderCount FROM ad_business_entity WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND deleted = 0
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
